The anomaly on 2025-10-16 in account JUNpaMa comes from instance family **fG8wYOz6XO**. It sits in application qnK under cloud service wpLAB.

**How I found it:** At first glance the anomaly looked like a big drop. Application qnK fell from 1,652 on 10-15 to 1,264 on 10-16, nearly all of it from two instance families:
- g9c1yzr6KG fell from 1,286 to 744.
- fG8wYOz6XO rose from 302 to 454.

Both families follow a repeating weekly cycle, so comparing against the day before is misleading. 2025-10-16 is a Thursday, so I compared it with the two previous Thursdays.

| Instance family | 2025-09-18 | 2025-10-02 | 2025-10-16 |
|---|---|---|---|
| g9c1yzr6KG | 744 | 744 | 744 |
| fG8wYOz6XO | 277 | 277 | 454 |

- **g9c1yzr6KG** cost exactly what it normally does on a Thursday, so its drop is just the usual weekly pattern.
- **fG8wYOz6XO** cost 176.40 more than its usual Thursday level. It ran 18 instances at 1.05 each, which comes to 453.60.
- **Everything else:** I compared every instance family in the account against the two-Thursday average, and no other family moved by more than about 5.

The same family also ran high on 10-17 (454 against the usual 277–302) and dropped to 0 on 10-18, so this looks like a short-lived spike in instance count.
